decisions.reason: Though no longer visibly promoted, it remains close to the core candle-arch craft range and the sunk investment in several models still encourages management to persist.
Its strong fit with the traditional Christmas pyramid business supports retention, even if weaker visibility now makes it easier to cut than at launch.
Management long had reason to justify this publicly announced flagship, but after several years without visible support its distant fit now makes withdrawal more likely than continued commitment.
Because it mainly serves the weakening electronic music-box initiative and never had much standalone visibility, it is a natural candidate for removal.
This accessory has little independent commitment behind it and is especially likely to be cut as resources are redirected to the established handcrafted range or new development.
